data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 晨光羽落的忠犬依偎
data.description: 晨光穿透白纱，洁白羽毛散落在凌乱的床单上。睡裙褪在一旁的阿斯特蕾亚全身发烫，像黏人的小猫般死死环抱住你的腰，把脸贴在你胸口，带着幸福纯真的傻笑沉沉贪睡。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with white ruffled sheets
data.action: tangled in bedsheets with scattered feathers, hugging partner waist tightly, bare skin flushed, sleeping with a peaceful radiant smile
data.lighting: brilliant morning sunlight illuminating scattered white feathers and tangled sheets
data.mood: sacred angelic surrender, pure heavenly peace, puppy-like clinginess
data.promptProse: Tangled in morning sheets covered in white feathers, Astraea hugs partner waist tight, smiling in peaceful post-passion bliss.
data.animaCaption: Astraea cuddling closely in bed amidst scattered angel feathers in morning sun.
